detail.title: Detection of Unrecognized Reasoning Limits and Metareasoning Experiment Design
detail.summary: This proposal continues investigations into unrecognized reasoning limits within cognitive architectures under project proj-reasoning-limits-001. We advance the empirical testing pipeline by proposing a reproducible python experiment using the numeric-observation instrument to evaluate metareasoning error detection patterns against established source frameworks.
